module: Manager of the game's post-effects (PostFX). On import it creates the common objects: state blocks PFX_DefaultStateBlock and PFX_DefaultBlitStateBlock, shaders PFX_PassthruShader and PFX_PassthruComputeShader, and the PostEffects AL_FormatBlit and AL_UpscaleBilinear (disabled at the start). It loads the effects from client/postFx/* (caustics, dof, edgeAA, fog, fxaa, glow, maskedScreenBlur, smaa, ssao, screenSpaceShadows) and can reapply the SSAO and DOF default values.
notes: initPostEffects and reloadPostEffects contain the same code (one require per effect); require caches, so reloading only runs the modules once unless the cache is cleared.
The global table postEffectCallbacks is published via rawset on _G; its onEnabled always returns true.

initPostEffects.desc: Loads all post-effect modules and keeps references to dof and ssao.

applyDefaults.desc: Reapplies the default values of ssao and dof (applyDefaults of each module), enables or disables the SSAOPostFx object according to $SSAOPostFx::Enable, then calls dof.updateDOFSettings().

postEffectCallbacks.desc: Global callback table (_G.postEffectCallbacks) used by the engine for PostEffects.

onEnabled.desc: Called when a PostEffect is enabled; returns true (allows the activation).
